title: Repentance Is Already on the Way
statement: The task is to find the longest Hamiltonian path from a_1 in a two-row graph where a_i links to b_{i-1}, b_i, b_{i+1}, each edge weighing 2 if its endpoints share a company and 1 otherwise, with n up to 2·10^5. Every such path goes straight column by column, then zigzags to the end and back, so the answer maximises prefix plus suffix sums over the turning column.
